notes: TMax is overwhelmingly dominant and correctly owns all 10 of final_top10. It has a large information-theory family (build a valid probability distribution, compute KL/JS/TVD), and crucially three tasks that SEARCH/SOLVE for a distribution: task_006780 root-finds a PDF parameter to hit a target variance within tolerance then computes KL; task_003486 optimizes a parameter vector to minimize KL to a target; task_007169 hand-rolls Newton/bisection to a 1e-6 tolerance and builds a distribution. Those three are near-exact skill+domain+form matches. The RTS shortlist was almost entirely false positives on the word 'distribution' (conda 'source distribution', DistributedLedger, GCD) - all discarded; RTS's real numeric content is generic .npy/GCD chores with no probability or optimization, so its scores are honestly low (mostly 1-2). TerminalWorld's best are a Julia optimization solve (tw_561688) and a constraint-search (tw_125882), both only overall 3. SWE-Smith and SWE-Rebench cannot match task_form; the best skill bridges are numerical-metric/formula fidelity (life4/textdistance distances, radon Halstead, dask lstsq) and probability-distribution libraries (sdv-dev/copulas, bashtage/arch GARCH, qutip distributions) plus optimization (smac3), all capped at overall 3. Merge should expect this task to be a TMax landslide; the other four corpora contribute little defensible signal beyond overall 3.
